comparisons.name: window-light
comparisons.description: The top 113 pt of the Safari window with three tabs, Aqua: the shadow above and beside the frame, the 38 pt toolbar with every control where the capture has it, the 25 pt tab bar and the first points of the page. Masked: the address in the Smart Search field and the band of the tab titles, which are text of the demo's own placeholder pages where the capture has third-party sites, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms. Not masked, and part of the score: the tab dividers (the library lays tabs out at equal widths, the capture caught them at 445, 432 and 420 pt), the Back chevron (enabled in the capture, where the tab has a history) and the Share glyph (the library's drawing).

comparisons.name: favorites-light
comparisons.description: The Safari window on its start page with the Bookmarks sidebar open, Aqua: frame and shadow, toolbar, the sidebar's switch and its line, the divider, the start-page canvas and the Favorites tiles' shadows. The Aqua capture is compared from 20 pt inside its left and right edges and 10 pt inside its top edge, and without its last 47 pt, which hold only the faint end of the shadow: the harness cannot draw a review sheet of the whole 1436 x 1052 pt image. Masked: the placeholder in the address field; the glyphs of the sidebar switch; the sidebar's rows, whose names and icons are the demo's own; the Favorites heading, every tile whole (site artwork in the capture, an abstract placeholder in the demo: a letter on a plain ground) and the tile titles. Not masked, and part of the score: the trailing end of the toolbar, with the new-tab cell of a window with one tab against the window's edge and Share and Tab Overview beside it (Share is dimmed on the start page, as in the capture).

comparisons.name: favorites-dark
comparisons.description: The Safari window on its start page with the Bookmarks sidebar open, Dark Aqua: frame and shadow, toolbar, the sidebar's switch and its line, the divider, the start-page canvas and the Favorites tiles' shadows. The whole capture is compared. Masked: the placeholder in the address field, which is focused and left-aligned as in the capture (the comparison clicks it); the glyphs of the sidebar switch; the sidebar's rows, whose names and icons are the demo's own; the Favorites heading, every tile whole (site artwork in the capture, an abstract placeholder in the demo: a letter on a plain ground) and the tile titles. Not masked, and part of the score: the trailing end of the toolbar, with the new-tab cell of a window with one tab against the window's edge and Share and Tab Overview beside it (Share is dimmed on the start page, as in the capture).

comparisons.name: picture-in-picture-light
comparisons.description: The top 63 pt of the inactive Safari window behind the floating video, Aqua, from the window's left edge to 60 pt past the video's left edge: the dimmed window controls and toolbar items, the address field, the tab bar of an inactive window with two tabs, and the video's shadow on the bars. The capture is the whole screen; the crop is the window's own rectangle, so no desktop picture is in it except in the window's rounded corner. Masked: that corner (5 pt); the leading end of the address field, where the demo's page has a Reader button and the captured site has none; the address; the speaker beside Reload, which the demo does not draw; the band of the tab titles; and the video, a third-party frame in the capture and a drawing in the demo. Not masked, and part of the score: the Back chevron (enabled in the capture, where the tab has a history) and the divider between the tabs (the library lays tabs out at equal widths, the capture's first tab is 626 pt wide).

The capture is the whole screen; the crop is the window's own rectangle, so no desktop picture is in it except in the window's rounded corner. Masked: that corner (5 pt); the leading end of the address field, where the demo's page has a Reader button and the captured site has none; the address; the speaker beside Reload, which the demo does not draw; the band of the tab titles; and the video, a third-party frame in the capture and a drawing in the demo. Not masked, and part of the score: the Back chevron (enabled in the capture, where the tab has a history) and the divider between the tabs (the library lays tabs out at equal widths, the capture's first tab is 626 pt wide).

comparisons.name: sharing-toolbar-light
comparisons.description: The last 160 pt of the toolbar of the Sharing capture's window, Aqua, with the Share menu open: Share with the bezel it has while its menu is open, Tab Overview, and the new-tab cell of a window with one tab against the window's edge, each where the capture has it. Masked: the window's rounded corner (6 pt), where the capture shows the desktop picture; and the top of the menu under the toolbar's last 6 pt, whose material shows the page behind it, a third-party page in the capture. Not masked, and part of the score: the Share glyph, the library's drawing, and the Tab Overview glyph, the demo's, and the Share glyph's outline, which differs a little from the capture's while the button is pressed.

comparisons.name: sharing-highlight-light
comparisons.description: The row under the pointer in the open Share menu against the Sharing capture, Aqua: the last 20 pt of the highlighted row before the menu's trailing rim, over its whole height, 98 to 119 pt from the window's corner. No glyph or label reaches this part, so nothing is masked. The crop is exactly the row's band in the capture, so it detects a highlight that leaves part of the band uncovered: a row that is higher, lower or shorter shows the menu's material in the crop and fails the budget. It cannot detect a highlight that reaches past the band, which leaves every compared pixel as it is; the pixels just outside the row in sharing-menu-light check that. The capture's highlight is vibrant, a gradient across the row that takes its colour from what is behind the menu (#1d71e6 over the page at the window's edge to #3182f2 at the rim, over the desktop picture); the library's is one colour, and the mean difference is that. The piece compared is the one over the desktop, where the capture's colour is nearest the library's; the rest of the row is over a third-party page.

comparisons.name: sharing-highlight-dark
comparisons.description: The row under the pointer in the open Share menu against the Sharing capture, Dark Aqua: the first 14 pt of the highlighted row inside the menu's leading rim, before the row's glyph, over its whole height, 98 to 119 pt from the window's corner. No glyph or label reaches this part, so nothing is masked. The crop is exactly the row's band in the capture, so it detects a highlight that leaves part of the band uncovered: a row that is higher, lower or shorter shows the menu's material in the crop and fails the budget. It cannot detect a highlight that reaches past the band, which leaves every compared pixel as it is; the pixels just outside the row in sharing-menu-dark check that. The capture's highlight is vibrant and takes its colour from what is behind the menu (#106ee1 over the page, #0965d2 over the desktop picture past the window's edge); the library's is one colour, and the mean difference is that. The piece compared is the one over the page, where the capture's colour is nearest the library's.

comparisons.name: preferences-light
comparisons.description: The top 124 pt of Safari's preferences window, Aqua: the shadow above and beside the frame, the 78 pt title bar and toolbar surface with the window controls (minimise and zoom disabled) and its bottom edge, and 8 pt of the pane. Masked: the title and the row of toolbar items, whose icons are Apple's artwork in the capture and stand-ins in the demo and whose labels are text. The pane is compared in preferences-pane-light and preferences-pane-dark.

comparisons.name: preferences-pane-light
comparisons.description: The whole of Safari's preferences window on its General pane, Aqua, at the height the pane gives it (508 pt, the capture's): frame and shadow, the bar, the pane's ground, the ends and caps of the eight pop-up buttons, the leading end of the Set to Current Page button (enabled, as in the capture), the checkbox and the help button, each where the capture has it. Masked: the title and the toolbar items (Apple's artwork and text); the label column; the titles of the pop-up buttons and of the push button, which are text; the Homepage field, which the capture caught focused with its text selected; the checkbox's title and the note under it. The control column stands 1 pt to the right of the capture's: the form is centred from the width of its labels, which are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

Masked: the title and the toolbar items (Apple's artwork and text); the label column; the titles of the pop-up buttons and of the push button, which are text; the Homepage field, which the capture caught focused; the checkbox's title and the note under it. The control column stands 1 pt to the right of the capture's: the form is centred from the width of its labels, which are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.
